label: Brent Crude
delta: Jumped Monday after Oman postponed the planned Sep 14 Iran-Gulf Hormuz talks in Salalah, wiping out the modest de-escalation discount markets had priced in over the weekend; Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remained shut and US claims of near-normal Hormuz flow were undercut by tanker-tracking data showing just 14 transits over the weekend

label: Saudi East-West Pipeline
value: Shut since Sep 11 (~4-5M bpd, 4-5% of global supply)
delta: Iraq-origin drone strikes forced a precautionary shutdown of Saudi Arabia's main Hormuz-bypass pipeline; industry sources say Yanbu's Red Sea export stocks cover only 5-7 days before exports must be curtailed

label: Bab el-Mandeb Daily Transits
delta: New second chokepoint risk: Houthi capture of Yemen's Mokha port and advance toward the strait cut Red Sea vessel crossings from 30 (Wed) to 12 (Thu), narrowing the Suez/Red Sea bypass route shippers have used to avoid the closed Strait of Hormuz

label: US Diesel Price
delta: Crossed $6/gallon for the first time as the Sep 9-10 shipping-attack wave and the new Red Sea front pushed Brent toward its $108 crisis peak

label: FAO Food Price Index
source: FAO (Aug 2026, released Sep 4 -- highest since late 2022)
delta: Up 1.9% from July's revised level and 2.5% y/y; broad-based across all five commodity groups -- sugar +11.9% m/m, cereals +2.2% m/m (highest since May 2024), dairy +2.3% m/m

label: Hormuz Daily Tanker Transits
value: 14 vessels over the weekend (tanker-tracking data) vs ~10M bbl/day claimed (US)
source: Tanker-tracking data via Al Jazeera / President Trump & Energy Secretary Chris Wright (Sep 14, 2026)
contestNote: President Trump said the US maintains "total control" of the strait and Energy Secretary Chris Wright said roughly 10 million barrels/day -- "two-thirds or north of two-thirds" of pre-war flow -- were moving under the US-led escort regime; independent tanker trackers instead counted just 14 vessel transits over the entire weekend, against a pre-war daily average of over 100 ships carrying roughly 20 million barrels
deltaNote: Traffic remains far below pre-war levels even as the US insists flows are largely restored; the gap has widened US-Gulf messaging tension just as the Sep 14 Salalah talks were postponed

label: 2026 Global Growth Forecast
contestNote: World Bank warns growth could fall to 1.3% in an adverse energy-shock scenario; IMF's own baseline is more optimistic at 3.1%

label: People at Risk of Acute Hunger (Conflict-Linked)
contestNote: Figure specific to Middle East conflict spillover; WFP's broader 2026 crisis-hunger caseload (318 million) is separate and driven by multiple conflicts

label: OPEC Spare Capacity Inaccessible
deltaNote: Concentrated in Saudi Arabia & UAE, both Hormuz-dependent

label: EU Extra Fossil Import Cost
